originalGroup.material:
New Teacher Name Story 032

Our new teacher’s name was unfamiliar to us. We copied a pronunciation from an old school video, assuming it must be right. When she introduced herself, the sound was different. One pupil wanted to correct her using the video. Our class captain suggested asking politely instead. The teacher explained that the video caption had linked her name to another person by mistake. She showed us the correct written name and said it slowly. We practised with her permission. Later, the school corrected the caption. I learned that an older recording could be useful evidence without being stronger than the person’s own clear introduction.

Use the correct one-word form of every given word to complete all five gaps.
1. Last month, our class ____1____ (bring) several models to the town hall.

3. The cleaned window is ____3____ (clean) than it was before the work.
4. Look! The goalkeeper is ____4____ (stop) a slow ball with both hands.
5. The organiser answered our question ____5____ (honest) about the missing materials.
